clauses_relied_on: freeze section 6: 'verify frozen Host checkpoint/config identity' is a P0 zero-fit preflight duty
freeze section 6: 'Only after P0 PASS may the protected-final reader be enabled.'
freeze section 5: 'Do not manufacture proxy rows.'

cause.one_line: The frozen Host checkpoint identity cannot be re-established for the gefcom_np family (LAGO_NP, GEFCOM14P), so P0 cannot PASS, the protected-final reader stays disabled, and no cell of the 16-cell matrix can be scored.
detail: P0 re-derives every frozen Host from the frozen contract and requires the re-derived checkpoint digest to equal the digest recorded in FREEZE_MANIFEST.json, and the re-derived Host prediction to be bit-exact against the frozen npz.

It fails at the first cell, LAGO_NP/PatchTST: re-derived CCFE99D1... is not reproducible; the frozen manifest records CCFE99D11BAACF1AA245368A... (full digest machine-readable in the family manifest).

Cause is a sub-1e-4 float32 numerical divergence, not a data/config/seed/recipe difference.  Re-derived and frozen OPEN-ROLE predictions agree to max abs 1.16e-04 (LAGO_NP/TimeMixer) and 7.59e-04 (LAGO_NP/LSTM) on prices of order 10-45, i.e. float32 rounding-level accumulation.  A different seed, dataset, split, host config or recipe produces O(1) differences, not 1e-4.

The frozen Host weights exist nowhere on disk: the family evidence publishes only FREEZE_MANIFEST.json plus open-role predictions (HOST_TRAIN/HOST_VAL/POST_TRAIN/DEV_EVAL).  No protected-span Host prediction exists anywhere, and none may be manufactured.
No machine, CPU, BLAS/oneDNN build or numpy identity is recorded in any frozen artifact of either family, so the environment that produced the gefcom_np Hosts cannot be restored.

family_split.note: the split is by dataset family, not by Host, and it is now complete: 16 of 16 cells characterised
family_split.nem_nord_family_NORD_DK1_NEM_SA1: 8 of 8 cells re-derive BIT-EXACTLY: every one of NORD_DK1 and NEM_SA1 x four Hosts has max abs open-role prediction delta exactly 0.0 and checkpoint_identity_exact true
family_split.gefcom_np_family_LAGO_NP_GEFCOM14P: 8 of 8 cells fail identity: every one of LAGO_NP and GEFCOM14P x four Hosts is numerically equivalent but not bit-identical, max abs open-role prediction delta 1.53e-05 to 0.000759 on prices whose frozen mean abs is 47-166
family_split.interpretation: the frozen Hosts are reproducible on this machine exactly when the family is nem_nord, so this environment is not generically broken; the gefcom_np frozen Hosts were produced under a numerical build this machine is not, and the difference is below the version string (compiled kernels / CPU ISA), which no frozen artifact of either family records

diagnostic_table.parallelism_note: run as 8 concurrent processes, each pinning torch.set_num_threads(1); single-threaded reductions are order-fixed, so concurrency changes no cell's bits.  A GPU was not used and must not be: it would change both the torch build and the device, making every digest comparison against the CPU-frozen manifests meaningless.
diagnostic_table.why_it_matters: p0_preflight.py raises at the first non-identical Host and therefore reports only the first failure; this table is what turns that into a complete 16-cell picture, and it is what localises the defect to one family rather than to the machine.

protected_final_access.reason: the reader is gated on P0 PASS by unlock_protected(); no P0_PASS.json exists
protected_final_access.windows_materialised: open roles only (HOST_TRAIN, HOST_VAL, POST_TRAIN, DEV_EVAL) on every code path executed
protected_final_access.read_count_evidence: every one of the 16 diagnostic cells records protected_final_windows_read = 0 and roles_present = [DEV_EVAL, HOST_TRAIN, HOST_VAL, POST_TRAIN]
